senses.gloss: को-विद mf(आ)n. (√ विद्) experienced, skilled, learned in (loc. gen., or ifc., e.g. अश्वेषु, or अश्वानाम् or अश्व-कोविद, ‘skilled in horses’), Mn. vii, 26; MBh.; R. &c.
को-विद m. pl. N. of the Kṣatriyas in Kuśa-dvīpa, BhP. v, 20, 16.
को-विदार m. ‘easily to be split’, or ‘to be split with difficulty’ (? cf. कुद्दल, कुद्दाल), Bauhinia variegata, Gobh.; MBh.; R.; Suśr.; Ṛtus.
one of the trees of paradise, Hariv. 7169; Lalit.
